newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Atomic to restart Tsuruga reactor on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Japan Atomic to restart Tsuruga reactor on Monday.

text.p: The Japan Atomic Power Co said it would restart a 357,000 kilowatt (kw) nuclear reactor at its Tsuruga plant at 4 p.m. (0700 GMT) on Monday.
The reactor, located in central Japan on the Sea of Japan coast, is expected to resume power generation at around 4 p.m. on Tuesday.
The boiling water reactor (BWR) was shut on October 7 for repairs on a recirculation pump seal.
The Tsuruga plant operates a 1.16 million kw pressurised water reactor as well as the boiling water reactor.
The plant supplies electricity to Kansai Electric Power Co Inc, Chubu Electric Power Co Inc and Hokuriku Electric Power Co Inc.
